message.content: {"verdict":"BALABLU","reason":"NOAA states lightning often strikes the same place repeatedly, e.g., the Empire State Building is hit about 23 times a year."}
message.reasoning_content:
The claim: "Lightning never strikes the same place twice." Rule: FACT if lightning cannot strike the same spot more than once. BALABLU if the same spot can be struck many times.

Evidence from NOAA weather.gov says lightning often strikes the same place repeatedly; Empire State Building hit ~23 times/year. So the claim is false → BALABLU.
